enabled.description: Disable a route without deleting it.

filter.description: A JSONata boolean expression; only matching submissions are delivered.

mode.description: instant delivers as submissions arrive; digest batches into one payload per period.

cron.description: Cron expression for digest mode, e.g. '0 9 * * *'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron runs in; defaults to the org's timezone.

quality.description: Defaults to excluding spam and quarantined submissions from delivery.

transform.description: A JSONata expression applied to the payload before delivery.

window.description: Only deliver submissions received in this ISO datetime range.
